reviewNature: The newly authored third case was reasoned through before materialization and checked again against its actual DE/EN bytes and exact tenths-of-eV arithmetic after materialization. This is not an independent second-agent review or inherited approval of the new case.
modelBoundary: Ordinary single-photon photoelectric emission; maximum kinetic energy applies only where the photon energy reaches the material work function. Intensity at fixed frequency is not photon energy.
thresholdReasoning: Increasing the work function from 2.0 to 3.2 eV raises f_G=W_A/h at unchanged initial photon frequency. A negative hf-W_A is a failure of the emission threshold, not a negative kinetic energy. Raising photon flux alone cannot fix that threshold within the stated model.
bilingualMeaning: DE and EN require the same prior qualitative prediction, controlled intervention comparison and subsequent maximum-energy interpretation.
preservationCheck: The two earlier application-case objects, both essential-understanding expectations and the coverage-expectations object are JSON-identical to P040s. Exactly one material-property variation axis and one third application case were added.
scopeOfPriorReviews: Both current D040t reviewers independently proposed the material-change transfer before the coordinator read both sealed results. They did not review this subsequently authored concrete profile body. Historical P040s and B034 records remain unchanged.
